test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pointing to a woman, Suman (a woman) said “She is the grandmother of my father-in-law's wife's son.” How is the woman related to Suman?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given Statement : Pointing to a lady, Suman (a lady) said "She is the grandmother of the son of my father-in-law's wife."

As only grandmother is given therefore there are two possibilities i. e. it can either paternal or maternal grandmother.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/108bf0555f2266ed13814cdce356f3737ce5630095b3b2fc0da0a25af6f06504.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4de3752977172093c651c2efc0b7788dcd4d1dc4811e8ff876070cdb7fb71da2.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree the lady is husband's either maternal or paternal grandmother of Suman.

Hence, "Husband's grandmother" is the correct answer.
